newsitem.title: POLAND: Polish c.bank ready to offer PLN 1 bln flood loan.
newsitem.headline: Polish c.bank ready to offer PLN 1 bln flood loan.

text.p: The Polish central bank is ready to help the government finance flood relief by lending it up to one billion zlotys at market rates, deputy bank president Witold Kozinski said on Tuesday.

Kozinski told a news conference that if the government accepted the loan offer the National Bank of Poland would start collecting deposits from individuals and institutions to offset the monetary impact of the loan.

"We are ready to offer the government a credit of up to one billion zlotys...this would be a credit solely for the removal of the flood damage and one should expect NBP efforts to neutralise its monetary impact," Kozinski said.
"Therefore for a limited period when the credit is outstanding the NBP would resume its deposit activity and accept deposits for six and nine months," he added.

On Monday Finance Minister Marek Belka said the government would seek to amend the 1997 budget to borrow one billion zlotys or more from the central bank to give the government more flexibility in funding reconstruction efforts.
